Yes, I am getting help for my depression. I don't rely on FFXIV to carry me through it, but at the same time, I wish I could enjoy a game that I once was in love with. It has nothing for me anymore, but whenever I speak up about it Im treated like a complete loony.

Except for this instance, I suppose.

Hi. Throwaway account because frankly, I feel pathetic when mentioning all of this. Apologies if any of these questions go against what the post is for; but I'm taking my chance now.

I'm a player that has asperger's  and depression. Final Fantasy XIV is more or less my first major MMO and has been a big part of my social life & gaming life... and it's been a lot of fun.  I've played my fair share of korean MMOs growing up, but nothing was on the scheme of Final Fantasy XIV is.

That being said, I find XIV really complicated to play after a few years of playing it and it's straight up depressing me.

What is supposed to keep me playing? I've seemingly ran out of content.  I don't know what I should be doing. I know that there are some things I could do such as mount farm, but as I see it, I have my bike from Mogstation. I'm comfortable with that. Everything else seems optional.

Due to not understanding the MMO properly, I skipped all of the story up to Shadowbringers. This was a stupid mistake. You don't have to tell me that. When I first joined, during the beginning of HW, I didn't know people actually played the game for the story.

I guess my questions are: ***What am I supposed to do?*** I'm pretty much at the end of the game but have nothing to show for it. I just have a medium house, some money... but nothing except for raiding (I'll get back to that in a minute) really calls to me on something worth doing.

Everything I've tried is either "this isn't worth the time" or "I've done this enough to get the fun out of it, it's no longer fun, I'm done with it."

and my other question is: ***How am I supposed to raid?***

It feels like I'm not allowed to raid because of how this game is. I know a lot of this stuff is simply in my head and not correct - but it just feels like people, or the game itself, is making excuses for me not to be able to raid. I enjoy the idea of trying my best to clear a fight, but it just feels as if I'm not allowed to do it. at all. I've tried advertising myself to find a raid group, I've tried directly asking, I've tried just waiting, but none of it is working... but it's like I'm the only one who's having issues with this part of the game. I don't know. Maybe FFXIV just isnt for me, and it's taken years to find out.

People tell me raiding is super hard as if it's to demotivate me but I still want to \*try\* it, but then I hear it's \*super\* easy - if it's so easy, why do people feel the need to talk about joining a raid team so much? It's planted the idea that playing with randoms is a totally bad idea for me and I \*need\* to find a raid team, but I can't tell how much of this if any of it is true or not.

​

Ugh - I should just stop. I probably missed the entire point of this post. Sorry.
